about: Documented Go-only compiler files exempt from the Go<->Ergo dual-compiler drift gate (scripts/compiler-drift). Every entry requires an existing checkout-relative file, a non-empty reason, and an owner.

exemptions.reason: Go-host-only foreign-key closure computation using go/build, go/parser, and go/types over embedded runtime/v1 and local Go modules; no self-hosted Ergo mirror in compiler/lower.
Go-host-only persistent content-hashed disk cache for Go foreign-key closures under build cache root; no self-hosted Ergo mirror in compiler/lower.
Go-host-only go/ast + go/types transitive Go call-graph closure walker for extern go law-ledger pinning; no self-hosted Ergo mirror in compiler/lower.
Go-host-only GOROOT standard-library type loader for goclosure; depends directly on Go's go/build, go/parser, and go/types; no self-hosted Ergo mirror in compiler/lower.
